label: flat on main-line exams; unseen bench pending
result: One big mixed-size training round with the lab recipe (train on everything examined + real-moves targets; 25.7k practice examples, ~2.4x the usual) landed within noise of the ordinary round on all six of the main loop's exams -- slightly fewer wasted moves on the standard boards, no change in puzzles solved. The recipe's proven win (never-seen boards) was not measured in this run.
conclusion: In the big loop, the recipe neither helped nor hurt on the usual exams after one round; the cheap never-seen-boards measurement is queued, and until then the recipe is recommended for generalization-facing loops only. Practical caveat: on 8-robot boards the extra data extraction is ~6x slower.
